execution_contract_proposal.echo_unsolicited_late_data: Separate address/command classification. Echo and transceive updates do not complete a solicited query. No on-wire transaction ID exists; identical late replies remain a correlation limitation, not solved by local generation tags.
execution_contract_proposal.cancellation: Before send: no bytes. After send: discard cancelled consumer output while retaining ownership until response/deadline; never infer rollback of a completed write.
execution_contract_proposal.write_policy: No blind setter retry; ACK alone does not confirm state. Reconnection never replays old writes.
execution_contract_proposal.timing_and_frame_limits: Next FSD/model window must approve exact bounds; no new normative limits introduced here.
execution_contract_proposal.opening_control_lines: No hardware opening authorized. Target USB SEND/CW/RTTY keying mappings must be inspected. Explicit DTR/RTS inactive intent and no flow control require backend verification; no glitch-free-open claim.
execution_contract_proposal.transmit_boundary: TX command knowledge may be catalogued later, but transmit execution/authority/halt belongs to #9. This proposal exposes no PTT setter.
execution_contract_proposal.receive_boundary: Consume #6 sample/source/profile/job identity and #7 common preprocessing; no new audio jobs, resampler, FFT or authentication.
execution_contract_proposal.runtime_scope: Implement only reviewed operations actually needed by the application first; broader catalogue knowledge does not expand runtime operation scope.

storage_boundaries.catalogue: Immutable versioned shared knowledge, provenance and completeness; no station handles/secrets/live state. JSON first; no SQL dependency selected.
storage_boundaries.station_configuration: Stable catalogue model ID/revision reference plus selected transport/address/settings intent. Stable-ID migration policy TBD; unknown IDs must not silently retarget another radio.
storage_boundaries.runtime_state: Connection identity, observed radio state, negotiated/observed capabilities and failures; never written back as universal catalogue truth.
storage_boundaries.implementation_registry: Our reviewed typed operations/codecs and verification evidence, distinct from Hamlib-reported capability.

compatibility_proof_plan.vendor_fixtures: Use independent manual-derived bytes from ic7300-manifest.json; no oracle produced by the codec under test.
compatibility_proof_plan.hamlib_reference: If pinned Hamlib binary becomes available, compare its observable normalized results against the same isolated scripted serial emulator; no physical device or network radio. Audit initialization/open side effects before execution.
compatibility_proof_plan.comparison: Compare frequency Hz, USB/LSB plus separately observed DATA state, RX/TX observations and explicit rejection/failure semantics; record intentional differences. Do not equate FIL1 with a fixed Hz bandwidth or assume Hamlib packet-mode names map without DATA evidence.
compatibility_proof_plan.not_required_equivalence: Internal design, exact polling sequence, cache behavior and retry algorithms need not match; user-visible subset must have an explicit behavior oracle.
compatibility_proof_plan.coverage: Enumerate compared operations/variants and unknown firmware cases; neither catalogue membership nor Hamlib stable status is our acceptance result.

ingestion_proposal.method: One pinned-source offline metadata export path, plus reviewed vendor/family command knowledge records. No source algorithm translation.
ingestion_proposal.initial_scope: IC-7300 proof, then incremental protocol families; do not bulk-copy curated tables under an assumption of unrestricted reuse.
ingestion_proposal.license_review: Keep source notices/licenses and extraction provenance; determine redistribution obligations for copied/derived material before publication. Tool output is not an automatic licensing exemption.
ingestion_proposal.implementation_gate: Next single-owner FSD/model integration and independent semantic/readiness review required before implementing catalogue, executor or adapters.
